T2_constants.ark_note: the ark's 2.5:1.5 = 5:3 = 1.667, 3.0% from phi: consecutive Fibonacci numbers, as small integers often are

T3_pi.note: the expected count assumes ratios spread over roughly 0.6 of a unit around each target; the bronze sea is the one case in a verse about a circle

bronze_sea_as_written.note: the pi value needs the conjunction removed; the same 111/106 ratio also occurs in Daniel's Aramaic 'Most High' (x7) and in 'his words' (222/212), none about circles

T4_electrical.comparison: a static shock is about 0.001 J; an electric fence pulse up to about 5 J; a defibrillator 150-360 J
T4_electrical.note: no charging source is described; with 2 cm of wood, 50 kV stores about 5 J, painful to dangerous but not the 'device' of popular claims

T5_magnetic.iron: absent from the tabernacle's furnishings; excluded from altar stones ('if you wield your tool on it you profane it', Exod 20:25; Deut 27:5) and from the temple site: 'no hammer or axe or any iron tool was heard in the House while it was being built' (1 Kgs 6:7)
T5_magnetic.calc: every named metal has magnetic susceptibility below 1e-5 in magnitude: the sanctuary is magnetically inert

T6_geometric.plato: Timaeus 55d-56a gives each element a solid: earth = the cube, fire = tetrahedron, air = octahedron, water = icosahedron
T6_geometric.timaeus_text: ς ὀκτὼ στερεὰς ἀπετέλεσεν, κατὰ τρεῖς ἐπιπέδους ὀρθὰς συναρμοσθείσης ἑκάστης· τὸ δὲ σχῆμα τοῦ συστάντος σώματος γέγονεν κυβικόν, ἓξ ἐπιπέδους τετραγώνους ἰσοπλεύρους βάσεις ἔχον. ἔτι δὲ οὔσης συστάσεως μιᾶς πέμπτης, ἐπὶ τὸ πᾶν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῇ κατεχρήσατο ἐκεῖνο διαζωγραφῶν. ἃ δή τις εἰ πάντα λογιζόμενος ἐμμελῶς ἀποροῖ πότε

T7_geographic.orientation: the tabernacle's entrance faces east (Exod 27:13); the glory enters Ezekiel's temple from the east (Ezek 43:2)
T7_geographic.camp: Num 2: twelve tribes, three on each side of the tabernacle; the breastpiece: twelve stones in four rows of three (Exod 28:17-21)
T7_geographic.note: the breastpiece is a 4 x 3 grid of the twelve tribes; the camp is a 4 x 3 arrangement of the same twelve around the centre
